name: LightRays-TS-TW
title: Light Rays
description: Soft grey-white beams spread from a point above the frame and fade toward the bottom on near-black. The beams drift slowly and lean toward wherever the pointer moves.
use: A dark hero needs a quiet spotlight glow that keeps its text readable.
avoid: The rays are dim: on a bright page or a small tile they are almost invisible.
a11y: Decorative and pointer-following, with no reduced-motion or keyboard option for the drift. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A very dark panel with a bright patch along the top edge that opens into a fan of pale beams. The light is a cool grey-white, hazy at its source, and fades almost to black in the lower half.
behaves: The beams sway and shift in brightness on a slow loop, never fully still. With the pointer following on, the fan's direction eases toward the cursor and drifts back when it moves away.
customise: Beam origin, colour, speed, spread, length, fade, pulse, pointer influence, noise and distortion are props. The two-beam blend is fixed.
weight: heavy: A full-screen shader renders beams and pointer easing every frame while visible.
issues: Beams are so dim against the black stage that they read as a faint smudge.
polishWhy: Clean and even, but the contrast is so low the effect nearly disappears.
